variants.form_note: h33-2-b2; PRUNE collar 2.5px (941 dots out, 941 refill at dcat>=3px); pred +0.001 DTI
variants.predicted_change: MODEL +0.0000..+0.0020 DTI (lineage-anchored +0.0010 central, refill assumed neutral); ranking arithmetic favors negative

mechanism_card.hypothesis: Cutting the collar from 2.0 to 2.5 px removes only the 941 R0 dots in the innermost diagonal shell (d_cat in (2.0, 2.5]); at that distance a dot's 3 px triangular kernel is >83% dominated by masked catalogue pixels, so those dots should pay false-positive mass with little collectable credit. Refilling them from the off-catalogue ridge pool should be weakly positive.
mechanism_card.mechanism: Under DTI = T / (0.2T + 0.2(S-M) + 0.8|G|) each unit-mass dot adds 0.2(1 - m_q) to the denominator and (1 - 0.2s)dT to the numerator. Known USGS/INGENIOUS pixels are masked pixel-exactly out of the label set, so a dot inside the 3 px (300 m) kernel footprint of a masked catalogue pixel can only collect credit from *new-fault* truth. Collar dots are swapped 1:1 for the highest exact-marginal-gain off-catalogue ridge dots (d_cat >= 3.0 px, r_min = 2.8 px) from the parent's own ranked pool, so total mass and mean spacing are held and only collar geometry changes.
mechanism_card.non_fault_mimic: Alluvial-fan head-cut scarps, pediment slope breaks and playa margins that parallel mapped range-front faults at 200-400 m; these mimic an unmapped splay and would make collar dots productive rather than wasteful.
mechanism_card.predicted_sign_and_size: MODEL +0.0000..+0.0020 DTI (central +0.0010 from 1.088e-6 DTI per removed collar dot x 941 dots, refill assumed neutral). Note the disagreement: the parent's own masking-blind ranking arithmetic prices the collar dots higher than the refill pool (negative), yet the lineage's one measured collar prune (0.2708 -> 0.2778 CLAIM) moved the other way, which is exactly why this axis is worth a slot. Live changes under 0.010 count as no evidence (public chunks only).
mechanism_card.falsifier: A live score below 0.2768 (>= 0.0010 under R0's 0.2778 CLAIM) falsifies the claim that the innermost diagonal shell is net false-positive dominated.
